shots.name: sam-out
shots.note: Sam’s rescue: the moment his door opens and he comes out
shots.caption: Far off, under everything, something moves. A long, heavy sound, like a building settling. The water shivers.

shots.name: alex-door
shots.note: Alex’s rescue: at his door, the proof
shots.caption: There’s still a little light.

shots.name: alex-out
shots.note: Alex’s rescue: the door open, Alex out
shots.caption: There’s still a little light.

shots.name: reunion
shots.note: The reunion in the crew room
shots.caption: ALEX“I thought I wasn’t going to see you guys again.”

shots.name: breach
shots.note: The breach through the windows, mid-beat
shots.caption: OFFICER REYES“MOVE. Everybody MOVE.”

shots.name: escape
shots.note: The escape: the junction hall under the jammed bulkhead
shots.caption: SAM“The door’s coming down— it’s jammed, it’s twisting—”

shots.name: street
shots.note: The surface: Oak Hollow Drive as you come down from the oak
shots.caption: Halfway to Sam’s the road isn’t there. The whole width of it is a hole. The Hendersons’ front yard has gone down into it, and the garage end

shots.name: jamie-death
shots.note: Jamie’s death at the Hendersons’: the moment it reaches him
shots.caption: Behind him, by the steps, a long hand comes up over the broken edge of the lawn. Then the rest of it.

shots.name: jamie-after
shots.note: After Jamie: the boys and Reyes
shots.caption: There’s still a little light.

shots.name: gates
shots.note: The final operation: gate 1 on the bridge
shots.caption: ALEX“In the water— BACK! Get back!”

shots.name: plug
shots.note: The final operation: the pins and the plug
shots.caption: There’s still a little light.

shots.name: hatch
shots.caption: You go through. Sam goes through. Something comes down the shaft behind you, a whole slab of the roof, and hits him.

shots.name: ride
shots.caption: Saturday. The sun not up yet but nearly.
